entities.name: Rootwater
entities.description: Saltwater lake on Icehaven in Keld, transferred from Rath during the Rathi Overlay, later also the name of the forest above it.

entities.name: Merfolk of Rootwater
entities.description: Once peaceable merfolk who became savage carnivores.

entities.name: Elves of Skyshroud
entities.description: Elves who coexisted with the merfolk and later grew Skyshroud.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: Forest magically grown by the elves above the lake.

entities.name: Evincars
entities.description: Rulers who genetically altered the merfolk.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who kept the forest warm and sacrificed herself to close the Time Rift.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that brought Rath's regions to Dominaria.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane the lake and its peoples were taken to.

events.summary: A portal drags the merfolk and elves, with a massive body of water, to Rath.
events.quote: The portal that dragged them to Rath snatched a massive body of water along with it.

events.summary: The alliance ends in a bloody battle as food dwindles; the elves magically grow Skyshroud.
events.quote: their partnership ended abruptly in a bloody battle

events.summary: The merfolk become savage carnivores and curse the elves and their forest, now called Rootwater.
events.quote: The merfolk cursed the elves and their new home, now named Rootwater .

events.summary: Rootwater appears on Keld after the Rathi Overlay; Freyalise casts a spell to keep the forest warm.
events.quote: it was saved by the planeswalker Freyalise , who cast a spell to keep the forest warm

events.summary: After Freyalise sacrifices herself to close the Time Rift, the forest's mana weakens and its inhabitants move away.
events.quote: After Freyalise sacrificed herself to close the Time Rift over Skyshroad
